reportTitle: 速效救心丸作为馈赠礼品的受赠人群适应症边界与无诊断者持药的获益—风险证据评价

claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎（Ligusticum striatum，Chuanxiong）与冰片（Borneolum syntheticum）两味组成，1982 年经中国药监（CFDA）批准上市。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJPs) emerges as a prominent traditional Chinese patent medicine utilized for the treatment of acute ischemic heart disease, which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982 … The pill is composed of Ligusticum striatum DC. (WFO accession number: wfo-0000362231, family Apiaceae, Chuanxiong Rhizoma) and Dryobalanops aromatica C.F.Gaertn. (WFO accession number: wfo-0000657511, family Dipterocarpaceae, Borneolum syntheticum).
claims.applicability: 组方与批准信息，直接适用于对本品的规范定位；批准年份 1982 为该试验引言所述。
claims.uncertainty: 批准年份与组方为该试验引言转述，官方注册记录未单独核验。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸批准文号为 Z12020025，规格每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA]). The SJP and placebo pills are provided by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (Tianjin, China). The placebo pills are similar to the SJP, with a comparable appearance. Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 批准文号与规格，直接适用于规范层面定位。
claims.uncertainty: 为试验方案转述，官方注册记录未单独核验。

claims.claim: 按《中国药典》要求，每丸含川芎以阿魏酸计不少于 15.0 μg、含合成冰片以冰片计 2.9～4.4 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: According to the Chinese Pharmacopoeia, each pill of SJPs is required to contain a minimum of 15.0 μg of Ligusticum chuanxiong, expressed in terms of ferulic acid (C 10 H 10 O 4 ), and 2.9 to 4.4 mg of Borneolum syntheticum, expressed in terms of Borneol (C 10 H 18 O).
claims.applicability: 药典含量要求，直接适用于制剂规格描述。
claims.uncertainty: 为该试验转述的药典条款，药典原文未直接核验。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的临床研究人群为气滞血瘀证（Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome）慢性稳定型心绞痛患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome).
claims.applicability: 直接说明本品临床研究以气滞血瘀证为入组证型。
claims.uncertainty: 为研究方案的入组描述，不等于说明书适应症原文。

claims.claim: 本品临床研究入组要求已确诊冠心病：心肌梗死病史，或冠状动脉造影／冠脉 CT 血管造影证实狭窄大于 50%，或非侵入性负荷试验阳性。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: ① history of myocardial infarction (MI); ② coronary angiography or computed tomography coronary angiography confirmation of stenosis greater than 50%; and ③ noninvasive imaging stress test diagnostic of coronary artery disease (CAD)
claims.applicability: 直接界定研究人群为已确诊冠心病者，是三类受赠人分层的依据。
claims.uncertainty: 为单中心方案的定义，其他研究的诊断标准可能略有差异。

claims.claim: 纳入 174 例不耐受长效硝酸酯的慢性冠脉综合征患者的多中心随机双盲安慰剂对照试验中，4 周时试验组 SAQ 总分改善≥20 分者占 60.9%，安慰剂组 39.1%（OR 2.43，95% CI 1.32～4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses. … randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … Specifically, 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% (OR = 2.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) of patients in the placebo group achieved the same level of improvement
claims.applicability: 本品质量最高的直接疗效证据，人群为已确诊冠心病（慢性冠脉综合征），终点为症状量表。
claims.uncertainty: 样本量 174 例、疗程 4 周、终点为症状量表而非临床事件，未评估远期结局。

claims.claim: 该试验 4 周内未报告不良事件，血脂指标组间差异无统计学意义。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … No participants reported experiencing adverse effects.
claims.applicability: 短期安全性观察，限于 4 周疗程与已确诊冠心病人群。
claims.uncertainty: 为受试者自我报告的短期不良事件，非主动系统监测，发生率无法据此估计。

claims.claim: 纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例冠心病患者的 meta 分析报告速效救心丸组心电图改善率优于对照（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26～1.38），多数纳入研究因缺乏双盲而 Jadad 评分偏低。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001). … The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 以心电图为替代终点、中国人群、对照为硝酸甘油/硝酸异山梨酯/复方丹参等。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究质量低、异质性高（I2=62.3%），终点为替代指标而非临床事件。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症，其终点为心电图、血脂与血流变等替代指标。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 界定该证据体可支持的结论边界：替代指标改善不能外推为临床事件减少。
claims.uncertainty: 作者自述的限制，原文未提供心血管死亡等硬终点的数据。

claims.claim: 韩国社区老年人定性研究中，20 名受访者中 18 名（90%）报告过处方或非处方药共享经历，其中处方药共享率 70%。
claims.sourceTitle: Medication Sharing Among Older Adults in South Korea: A Qualitative Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 20 participants were included in the study. Among them, 18 participants (90%) reported medication-sharing experiences with prescription or over-the-counter medications, and 16 (80%) reported sharing medications with family or relatives. … The prescription medication sharing rate was 70% (14 of 20 participants) overall
claims.applicability: 为老年人中处方药转赠/共享行为普遍性的直接定性证据，向中国家庭馈赠场景外推受文化差异限制。
claims.uncertainty: 定性研究，20 例，非代表性样本，不能据此估计中国人群现患率。

claims.claim: 借用他人药物者可能错误自我诊断并延迟就医；该定性研究记录到因先取用他人药物而推迟就医的情形。
claims.sourceTitle: Medication Sharing Among Older Adults in South Korea: A Qualitative Study
claims.supportQuote: Individual borrowers may inaccurately self-diagnose their conditions and delay visits to healthcare professionals when they can obtain medications from others … In some cases, appropriate treatment by healthcare professionals was delayed owing to medication-sharing behavior
claims.applicability: 支持无诊断持药者症状自我归因与就诊延迟风险，为共享行为的一般性证据，非本品特异。
claims.uncertainty: 定性证据，未量化延迟时长，未涉及速效救心丸。

claims.claim: 无人监督用药对多重用药老年人可带来脑血管事件、认知损害或下降、谵妄与跌倒等风险。
claims.sourceTitle: Medication Sharing Among Older Adults in South Korea: A Qualitative Study
claims.supportQuote: unsupervised use of drugs targeting the central nervous system (CNS) can pose risks for older adults with polypharmacy, leading to cerebrovascular events, cognitive decline or impairment, delirium, and falls
claims.applicability: 为老年多重用药人群中无人监督用药风险的证据，指向转赠长辈场景的潜在危害。
claims.uncertainty: 原文针对中枢神经系统药物，外推至速效救心丸受机制与人群限制。

claims.sourceTitle: Prevalence of borrowing and sharing prescription medicines and associated socio-demographic factors: findings from COBERS health centres in northern Uganda
claims.supportQuote: Socio-demographic factors and Chi-squared test results for borrowing and sharing prescription medicine, n = 1614 … 35.9% (95% CI 33.5–38.2%) of the study participants had borrowed prescription medicines during the study period while 32.7% (95% CI 30.4–34.9%) of the study participants had shared their prescription medicine during the study period.
claims.applicability: 为处方药借用/共享普遍性的定量证据，非洲与多国数据，向中国场景外推受限。
claims.uncertainty: 横断面、自报，存在社会期望偏倚；不同人群现患率差异大，不可直接外推。

claims.claim: 首次急性冠脉综合征女性（n=39）的定性研究中，多数人将症状归因于血糖波动、反流、进食、紧张、衰老等非心脏原因，反流为最常见的归因。
claims.sourceTitle: Symptom recognition and treatment-seeking behaviors in women experiencing acute coronary syndrome for the first time: a qualitative study
claims.supportQuote: Participants included 39 women who had experienced ACS for the first time. … most women attributed their symptoms to a non-cardiac cause, such as fluctuations in blood glucose level, acid reflux, heavy food, stress, COVID-19, lung problems, muscle overuse, or aging. Acid reflux was the most commonly attributed cause.
claims.applicability: 支持症状自我归因错误这一风险，为无诊断者自行判断症状的普遍性证据。
claims.uncertainty: 定性研究、伊朗女性人群，向中国老年人外推受限；非速效救心丸特异。

claims.claim: 出现持续不缓解的胸痛或不适（可为压榨感、烧灼感或消化不良感）应立即呼叫急救（英国为 999）；这可能是心脏病发作，需立即就医。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: - you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 急性胸痛的安全边界，本地化急救号码为中国的 120。
claims.uncertainty: 为英国国民健康服务体系指引，急救号码经本地化处理。

claims.claim: 荷兰初级保健的机会性房颤筛查整群随机对照试验中，47 个筛查诊所对 49 个常规诊所各随机抽取 200 名 65 岁以上无房颤史者，筛查组新诊断房颤 1.62%、常规组 1.53%，校正比值比 1.06（95% CI 0.84～1.35），即机会性筛查未提高检出率。
claims.sourceTitle: Opportunistic screening versus usual care for detection of atrial fibrillation in primary care: cluster randomised controlled trial
claims.supportQuote: 47 intention-to-screen and 49 usual care primary care practices in the Netherlands … In each practice, a fixed sample of 200 eligible patients, aged 65 or older, with no known history of atrial fibrillation in the electronic medical record system, were randomly selected. … 144 (1.62%) new diagnoses of atrial fibrillation in the intention-to-screen group versus 139 (1.53%) in the usual care group were found (adjusted odds ratio 1.06 (95% confidence interval 0.84 to 1.35)).
claims.applicability: 为以单导联心电等设备作居家监测的替代方案提供了阴性结局证据，65 岁以上无房颤史者。
claims.uncertainty: 为荷兰初级保健人群、机会性筛查而非连续居家监测，外推需谨慎。

claims.claim: 胸痛原因多样，多数并非心脏问题；不应自行诊断，如有疑虑应就医。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Most chest pain is not a sign of anything serious but get medical advice just in case. … Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 支持「症状是否缓解不得用作是否就医依据」的安全边界，为通用胸痛处置原则。
claims.uncertainty: 为英国国民健康服务体系指引，向中国场景外推时急救与就医路径需本地化。

claims.claim: 国家药监局综合司于 2026 年印发《处方药网络零售合规指南》（药监综药管函〔2026〕282 号）。
claims.sourceTitle: 中日医药信息网·监管动态
claims.identifier: 药监综药管函〔2026〕282 号（门户转载）
claims.supportQuote: 国家药监局综合司关于印发处方药网络零售合规指南的通知 药监综药管函〔2026〕282号 2026-06-03
claims.applicability: 为处方药网络零售存在现行合规指南这一事实的规范线索，正文条款未取得。
claims.uncertainty: 门户转载的标题线索，指南正文与条款号未取得，故只作发文事实引用。

claims.claim: 系统评价显示借用处方药的现患率为 5% 至 51.9%、共享（出借）为 6% 至 22.9%。
claims.sourceTitle: Prevalence of borrowing and sharing prescription medicines and associated socio-demographic factors: findings from COBERS health centres in northern Uganda
claims.supportQuote: the prevalence of prescription medication borrowing ranges from 5% … to 51.9% … The review further shows that the prevalence of sharing prescription medicine ranges from 6% to 22.9%
claims.applicability: 为处方药借用/共享现患率的系统评价区间（Beyene 等），经 Obol 2018 全文转引，可逐字追溯。
claims.uncertainty: 原文系转引 Beyene 等系统评价，区间跨度为多国研究合并结果，非中国人群现患率。

claims.claim: 该试验干预为速效救心丸每次 5 丸、每日 3 次舌下含服；SAQ-SS 连续变量的组间差为 5.68（95% CI 2.37～8.99）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: all participants were instructed to orally administer the study medication sublingually after meals, three times a day, taking 5 capsules each time (total of 15 capsules per day), continuously for 4 weeks. … the SJPs intervention resulted in an improvement of 5.68 (95% CI = 2.37 to 8.99, P < 0.001, SJPs vs. placebo: 15.46 vs. 9.78
claims.applicability: 为已确诊冠心病（慢性冠脉综合征）人群的给药方案与连续变量效应量，直接支持疗效数值。
claims.uncertainty: 为单个试验的组间差估计，样本量 174 例，未作多重校正说明。

claims.claim: 说明书适应症「气滞血瘀型冠心病，心绞痛」以冠心病诊断为必要前提，而临床研究将冠心病界定为心肌梗死病史、冠脉狭窄＞50% 或负荷试验阳性；故仅有心血管危险因素而无冠心病诊断者、以及无症状且无危险因素者均落在适应症表述之外。
claims.method: 说明书索引件功能主治为「用于气滞血瘀型冠心病，心绞痛」，其中「冠心病」为该适应症的必要诊断条件；纳入研究将冠心病诊断为心肌梗死病史、冠脉造影或冠脉CT血管造影狭窄＞50%、或无创负荷试验阳性三者之一。无冠心病诊断者不满足上述任一条件，因而不满足适应症所要求的诊断前提。
claims.assumptions: 说明书适应症中的「冠心病」与纳入研究采用的临床诊断定义一致；说明书未对无诊断人群另作适应症规定。
claims.sensitivity: 若不同版本的说明书对证型或诊断的表述不同，或存在针对无诊断人群的适应症修订，则这一边界相应移动；本推导的强度受说明书官方现行文本未获核验的限制。
claims.applicability: 仅用于三类受赠人与适应症范围的关系判定，不构成对无诊断者用药的临床推荐。
claims.uncertainty: 依赖说明书索引件转述的适应症原文，官方现行文本未核验。
